recipe.visualDefinition: A centered medium portrait of a blonde woman in a lace top, framed by vibrant, stylized floral clusters in the corners and overlaid with large, elegant script lettering across the lower third. The background features soft-focus rustic elements like weathered wood and pink flowers, tied together with a thin dotted border and subtle lace-like vector overlays.
coreVisualRelationships: The large script text anchors the subject's torso and creates a base for the composition.
Floral clusters in the top-left and bottom-right corners create diagonal balance.
The soft, warm tones of the portrait contrast with the deep purples and teals of the graphic flowers.
coreInvariants: Thin dotted rectangular border framing the inner content.
High-contrast script typography with long, sweeping swashes.
Combination of realistic photography and flat/stylized graphic floral elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally positioned, medium shot from waist up, filling the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark purple script text at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the bold typography, then circles out to the floral corners and border details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized in the upper right and left background to allow the subject's hair and the floral graphics to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm neutrals and cream (subject's clothing and skin tones).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep plum and dark purple (typography and primary floral elements).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal, yellow, and bright pink (secondary floral accents).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The portrait is desaturated and high-key, while the graphic overlays are highly saturated and dark-valued.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elegant cursive script with high stroke contrast.
letterConstructionRules: Monolinear swashes extending from capital letters.
Vertical stress with slight right-leaning slant.
Open loops in descenders and ascenders.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended 'D' swash that circles back toward the center.
Terminal 'y' with a long, sweeping tail that underlines the name.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant script paired with minimal geometric border elements.
graphicDevices: Subtle lace/mandala vector overlays in the background

candidateDirections.reason: Similar hand-written feel with elegant connections.
Classic formal script with clean loops.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus outdoor portrait of a blonde woman in a cream lace top against a rustic wooden background with pink flowers. Add stylized floral graphics in the top-left and bottom-right corners and a thin dotted border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, dark plum script lettering in the lower third, ensuring the flourishes overlap the subject's torso elegantly.

verificationChecks: Text is legible against the cream clothing.
Floral graphics appear as flat illustrations, not photos.
Dotted border is consistent and thin.
Typography flourishes do not obscure the subject's face.

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script flourishes feel integrated and not just pasted on.
Ensure the floral graphics don't look too realistic compared to the photo.
Verify the dotted border is perfectly rectangular.
Confirm the color of the text matches the darkest tones in the floral graphics.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key rustic portrait with flat, saturated floral corner graphics and a dominant, flourished script overlay in a dark contrasting tone.
